title: MicroSim Growth Network Effect
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify the stocks (Global MicroSims, Intelligent Textbooks, Teachers Aware) and the variables (Demand for Textbooks, Demand for MicroSims) that make up the causal loop diagram
Trace the two reinforcing loops R1 (Textbooks to Teachers Aware to Demand for Textbooks) and R2 (MicroSims to Textbooks to Teachers Aware to Demand for MicroSims) around the network
Explain why every edge carrying a positive polarity produces reinforcing rather than balancing feedback
Predict how a shock such as a major publisher releasing an intelligent textbook propagates through both loops over time
Evaluate which variable, such as teacher awareness or barriers to MicroSim creation, acts as the highest-leverage point in the system
